title: Response lifecycle sentryboard: model & route percentile + IO-mode lens
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a 'Response Lifecycle Sentryboard' that unifies percentiles (p50/p95/p99) and error overlays by model and route, with a clear IO-mode breakdown (streaming vs blocking). This board will surface correlated traces via new tracehooks and consume the revamped metrics/log pipeline (prometheus -> long-term TSDB + vector logs). Goal: make it trivial for support, SREs, and PMs to diagnose regressions caused by model changes, routing fallbacks, or IO-mode mismatches.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard exposes p50/p95/p99 for every model-route combination for last 1h/6h/24h windows
Streaming vs blocking IO-mode split is selectable and backed by a stable tag on metrics (io.mode)
Tracehook link opens the trace explorer filtered to the same cohort and attaches request payload fingerprint
Error-rate and 5xx/4xx overlays are present and can be toggled on/off per-panel
Board queries use new metric names from the pipeline transformation (redwood.request.latency_ms_histogram, redwood.request.errors_total)
Load tested at 10k dashboard queries/day without causing alerts on our observability cluster
comments: 2025-03-12 - Aisha: Kickoff meeting with SRE, Telemetry, and Console UX. Agreed to prototype with a single model-family (rw-open-7b) and the top 10 customer routes.

2025-03-13 - Marcus: PoC queries drafted in Grafana; found that the histogram -> percentile rollup causes high-cardinality when combined with route and io.mode. Decided to pre-aggregate by (model_family, route, io_mode) in the TSDB ingestion job.
2025-03-14 - Priya (Telemetry): We'll add an io.mode label in the vector pipeline; PR created: https://github.com/redwood/telemetry/pull/413 (pending review).
2025-03-16 - Marcus: Implemented tracehook enrichment: request metadata (model_version, route, io_mode) is injected as tags. Integration tests added. PR: https://github.com/redwood/serve/pull/2891

2025-03-18 - UX Review: Design suggested a compact percentile sparkline with hover-to-drill for p50/p95/p99 and an inline 'compare to baseline' toggle. UX spec in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OBS/Response+Sentryboard+Spec
2025-03-20 - Decision: To avoid cardinality explosion we will limit default dashboard to 'top routes by qps' and add a filter to expand. Follow-up ticket to index cold routes (ENG-274183).
2025-03-21 - Marcus: Manual QA on staging looks good. Need final cloud-cost estimate for long-term retention of percentile rollups.
implementation_notes: Phase 1: Ingest io.mode label in Vector pipeline; transform latency histogram to a 1m pre-aggregated quantile rollup keyed by (model_family, route, io_mode)
Phase 2: Add tracehook enrichment and a light-weight trace link canonicalizer to reduce trace link noise
Phase 3: Build Grafana panels with templated variables for model_family, route, and time window. Use derived fields to compute p50/p95/p99 from the pre-aggregated series.
Phase 4: Add alerting rules for percentile regression (p95 increased > 30% over baseline) and error-rate bump (>5xx rate increase of 3x) with annotations pointing to related PRs and trace links
Trade-offs: Pre-aggregation reduces resolution for ad-hoc percentile queries but keeps TSDB cardinality manageable. We prioritize production SLO signal over unlimited ad-hoc slicing.
Testing: synthetic traffic generator will exercise streaming and blocking endpoints with controlled latency distributions (scripts in github.com/redwood/telemetry/tools/synth)
Rollout: dark-launch panels for 48h, then enable for SRE/Support group, then org-wide
